description: Research-informed fixed structural recommendations for the active blog-post template.

faq.inclusion: Include when genuine reader follow-up questions improve the article.

research_basis.source: Google Search Central: Creating helpful, reliable, people-first content
research_basis.application: Use a fixed baseline as an editorial planning aid while prioritizing original value, clear sourcing, expertise, and reader usefulness.

research_basis.source: Citera: Analysis of 350,000 B2B SaaS Articles
research_basis.application: Use the observed B2B SaaS and AI-cited content patterns as a practical baseline for article length, section depth, citations, evidence, and expert input.
